description: make-skill — spec check on every SKILL.md write. The hook exits 0 without output for any path that is not a SKILL.md, so installing this plugin globally changes nothing in projects that do not author skills. It applies the Agent Skills spec floor only (no --house), so it never imposes this repo's own conventions on someone else's skill. It never blocks: PostToolUse runs after the write, and the result is advice, not a veto.
